primary_role_under_test: GPT-5.6 Sol High HQ pre-adoption adjudication

adjudication_elapsed.provenance: ChatGPT session execution timer returned by safe prior-reasoning summary
adjudication_elapsed.includes: live Git reconciliation, Sol return reading, independent evidence checks, digest recomputation, runtime-closure adjudication, final shadow disposition
adjudication_elapsed.excludes: creation/packaging of this benchmark GitHub branch after the user subsequently requested it

turn_start_clock_context.note: Turn-arrival context supplied minute-level time; do not fabricate second-level start timestamp.

reviewer_lane_asymmetry.detail: The original Sol reviewer commission named Omega-1/C4B/D2P exact refs but those three inputs were not ancestral to the review branch. The later Space Bunny ALT-B commission added explicit origin fetch instructions for those same exact inputs.
reviewer_lane_asymmetry.scoring_instruction: Treat explicit fetch instructions as an orchestration advantage given to Space Bunny, not as a model-discovered capability.

hq_input_condition.sol_hq_received: completed Sol reviewer return plus live repository state
hq_input_condition.intended_space_bunny_hq_condition: completed Space Bunny reviewer return plus equivalent live repository state

contamination_record.event: A final branch-status check performed after adjudication exposed the ALT-B branch's commit-message summary because the branch had returned by then.
contamination_record.instruction_to_astra: Score the Sol HQ adjudication from the evidence and disposition recorded before this status check. Do not treat the later visibility of the ALT-B commit message as contributing evidence.

timing_caution: Compare role-local elapsed times, not branch packaging/commit overhead. Repository/API latency is part of interactive task latency but may vary across surfaces.
